text: もたせていると　せんとうに　でなくても　その　ポケモンは　けいけんちを　わけてもらえる。

structure.en: if you have it holding this

structure.jp: せんとうに　でなくても
けいけんちを　わけてもらえる。
structure.en: can get a share of the Exp. Points

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'if' or 'whenever': when the first thing is true, the second always follows. もたせていると = 'if you have it holding this'.

patterns.name: 〜なくても
patterns.explanation: なくても on a verb means 'even if not'. せんとうに　でなくても = 'even if it doesn't go into battle'.

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.explanation: てもらう says someone does the action for you and you benefit; もらえる makes it 'can get'. わけてもらえる = 'can get a share handed to it'.
